annotations.title: Build a deck end-to-end with the AI pipeline

description: Stage 2 of the app's generation pipeline: assembles an approved outline into a saved deck — designed layouts, copy, AI/stock imagery, then the quality loop (a vision judge scores the rendered deck and the worst slides get a polish pass) before saving. This is the full in-app experience over MCP: use generate_outline first, then this. Returns the new deckId plus the quality report (initial → final score, revised slides). Style precedence: styleId > personalityId > templateId; personalityId also takes a saved Style's own id (`saved-…` from list_styles) and an id that matches nothing is an error, never a silent fallback. `imageSource` sets the whole deck to stock photos ("stock"), generated images ("genai") or the policy ("auto", default). Each image slot in the outline may carry `source`: "stock" (real photo), "generate" (generated or drawn) or "auto" (default; the policy picks, and a real-world scene may use stock even under an imageStyle). Repairs made to a slide's slots, and the deck gates that capped the quality score, are listed in the reply.
